title: Targeting LGALS1 via CAF-Derived Extracellular Vesicles Synergizes With αPD-1 to Reverse Immunosuppression and Sensibilize Chemo-Immunotherapy for Colorectal Cancer.
snippet: Colorectal cancer (CRC) exhibits intrinsic resistance to conventional therapeutic regimens. By integrating single-cell and bulk transcriptomic data from CRC cohorts, we demonstrate that proliferative capacity alone constitutes an inadequate prognostic predictor.
